parameters.content:
## Challenge 06 · The Support Queue

**Community Weekly Challenge · Season 2**

A fictional support desk has **24 tickets**. Count all open tickets, then the urgent tickets within that open queue. Build with native n8n nodes.

**Starter, not a finished solution.** Add the calculation nodes in the two work areas. Both answer cards are blank.

**No AI assistance**, including interpreting, planning, generating, debugging, solving or explaining this challenge.

[Read Challenge 06](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/challenge-06) · [Your account](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/status) · [Register](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/register)

[Challenge rules](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/challenge-06#rules) · [Untimed practice](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/challenge-06/practice/data) · [n8n documentation](https://docs.n8n.io/)

Personal data and submission follow Challenge 06's participation window. Importing this workflow does not open participation.

## 2 · One HTTP request, two questions

Enter your username and key in **Settings**. Keep the supplied base URL and HTTP Authentication **None**.

**Get tickets** calls `GET /data` with query `file=tickets` and your `username`, plus the `x-participant-key` header. **Ticket rows** splits its `rows` array into 24 items. Both question branches use these same items. **No second data request is needed.**

Run **Start** when ready. The first successful personal fetch starts your timer. Re-fetching preserves the same tickets and original start. Use untimed practice first.

## Question 1 · How many tickets are open?

**Source: Ticket rows from the shared HTTP request.** There is no separate Question 1 data endpoint.

Count tickets whose `status` equals **OPEN**. Build a native Filter and Summarize Count on `ticket_id` in the empty space below. Connect an enabled path from **Ticket rows** through your calculation to **Question 1 answer**.

The Edit Fields node is an **output card**, not a fetch or calculation. Map the computed Count field directly to **b1**, set its type to **Number**, and keep it in the export. It is intentionally blank and disconnected until you build that path.

Do not type a count, use arithmetic, group records or create a third answer.

## Question 2 · How many open tickets are urgent?

**Source: the same Ticket rows used by Question 1.** There is no separate Question 2 data endpoint.

Count tickets whose `status` equals **OPEN** and `priority` equals **URGENT**. Closed urgent tickets do not count. Reuse the open-ticket branch or build a native two-condition branch, then Count `ticket_id`. Connect the Count output to **Question 2 answer**.

This Edit Fields node is the second **output card**. Map the computed Count field directly to **b2** and set its type to **Number**. It is intentionally blank and disconnected until you build that path.

Do not add the answers together or create b3. All status/priority combinations occur and both counts are nonzero.

## 5 · Finish and fair play

1. Copy **both computed counts** into the Challenge 06 website form. Its optional **Check both answers** sends one paired `POST /check` with both totals and your workflow. It returns overall correctness only. There are no separate Q1/Q2 check HTTP nodes.
2. Submit both answers, your sanitized workflow JSON and your own explanation of **40 to 2,000 characters and at least eight words**, with both rule acknowledgements.
3. A supported correct final enters the leaderboard automatically. The server validates native calculations and the tickets contributing to each Count. The first accepted evidence and finish stay locked. **No pending replay or human approval** is part of ordinary season-time acceptance.

**Clock:** first successful personal fetch to first accepted final. Practice is untimed. Weekly rank points follow **15 / 12 / 12 / 11**, with exact ties sharing rank and points. Reward review happens at season end.

**No AI assistance of any kind.** No Code, Function, AI, Agent, MCP or Tool nodes, hardcoded totals or executable code hidden in expressions.

**Before export:** blank Settings.key and remove all credential references and pinned data. Keep Settings.username for your account binding. Never export participant keys.

[Open Challenge 06 submission](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/challenge-06#submit) · [Leaderboard](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/results) · [Rules](https://marketing.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/cwc/challenge-06#rules)

Data and submission are available only during Challenge 06's participation window.
